info.title: Umbraco.Cli
info.description: Cross-platform CLI for Umbraco CMS. Manage content, media, document types, languages, members, users, dictionary items and webhooks from the terminal or any AI agent that can invoke a subprocess. Produces structured JSON output by default when stdout is piped.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Umbraco CLI — manage your Umbraco CMS from the terminal.

Quick start:
  umbraco auth login --host https://mysite.com
  umbraco content list --output json
  umbraco content list | jq '.data[].name'

All commands support --output json (default when stdout is piped).
Use UMBRACO_HOST, UMBRACO_CLIENT_ID, UMBRACO_CLIENT_SECRET for CI/CD.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --host
options.description: Umbraco instance base URL (overrides config / UMBRACO_HOST).

options.name: --token
options.description: Raw bearer token (overrides credential store).

options.name: --output
options.description: Output format: json | human | csv (default: json when piped, human in terminal).

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress success confirmations (e.g. "Deleted."). Requested data, errors, and exit codes are unaffected. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Write HTTP request/response details to stderr. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview the HTTP request a write command would send (method, URL, body) without executing it. No effect on read commands. [default: False]

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the confirmation prompt on destructive commands (delete). Required to run a destructive command non-interactively (piped/scripted/agent). [default: False]

options.name: --readonly
options.description: Block all write operations (create/update/delete/publish) for this session. Can also be set with UMBRACO_READONLY=1. [default: False]

options.name: --fields
options.description: Comma-separated fields to keep in JSON output (e.g. id,name), in that order. Trims each result to those top-level fields to keep output small.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to config file (default: <path>).

options.name: --profile
options.description: Named credential profile to use (see 'auth profiles'). Also settable with UMBRACO_PROFILE. Defaults to the configured default profile.

commands.name: auth
commands.description:
Manage authentication with your Umbraco instance.

Examples:
  umbraco auth login --host https://mysite.com --client-id <id> --client-secret <secret>
  umbraco auth whoami
  umbraco auth logout

commands.name: login
commands.description:
Authenticate with an Umbraco instance using Client Credentials.
Credentials are saved to config for future calls.

Examples:
  umbraco auth login
  umbraco auth login --host https://mysite.com --client-id <id> --client-secret <secret>
  umbraco auth login --output json --host https://mysite.com --client-id <id> --client-secret <secret>

options.name: --client-id
options.description: OAuth2 Client ID from the Umbraco API Users section.

options.name: --client-secret
options.description: OAuth2 Client Secret from the Umbraco API Users section.

commands.name: logout
commands.description:
Remove stored Umbraco credentials for a profile (the default profile unless --profile is given).

Examples:
  umbraco auth logout
  umbraco auth logout --profile prod

commands.name: profiles
commands.description: List saved credential profiles and which one is the default.

commands.name: use
commands.description: Set the default credential profile.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The profile to make the default.

commands.name: whoami
commands.description:
Show the currently authenticated backoffice user and instance details.

Examples:
  umbraco auth whoami
  umbraco auth whoami --output json

commands.name: doctor
commands.description:
Diagnose connectivity, TLS, credentials, authentication, and the target instance version.

Examples:
  umbraco auth doctor
  umbraco auth doctor --output json

commands.name: content
commands.description:
Manage Umbraco content items (create, read, update, delete, publish).

Examples:
  umbraco content list --output json
  umbraco content get <id>
  umbraco content create --content-type textPage --name "My Page"
  umbraco content publish <id>

commands.name: list
commands.description:
List content items. Returns a paginated list of top-level or child content nodes.

Examples:
  umbraco content list
  umbraco content list --parent <id> --take 50
  umbraco content list --output json | jq '.data[].name'

options.name: --parent
options.description: Filter by parent content item ID (UUID). Omit for root items.

options.name: --skip
options.description: Number of items to skip for pagination. [default: 0]

options.name: --take
options.description: Maximum number of items to return. [default: 20]

commands.name: get
commands.description:
Get a content item by its UUID, including all property values.

Example:
  umbraco content get 3f7a8b2e-1234-5678-abcd-ef0123456789

commands.name: create
commands.description:
Create a new content item. Supply --json-body for full property control.

Examples:
  umbraco content create --content-type textPage --name "About"
  umbraco content create --content-type textPage --name "Child" --parent <id>
  umbraco content create --content-type blogPost --name "Post" --json-body ./body.json

options.name: --content-type
options.description: Alias of the document type to create (e.g. textPage, blogPost). Required unless --json-body or --schema is used.

options.name: --name
options.description: Display name for the new content item. Required unless --json-body or --schema is used.

options.name: --parent
options.description: Parent content item UUID. Omit to create at the root.

options.name: --json-body
options.description: Path to a JSON file (or - for stdin) containing the full create request body (overrides other flags).

options.name: --schema
options.description: Print the JSON Schema for the --json-body request and exit (no host/auth needed). [default: False]

commands.name: update
commands.description:
Update an existing content item by replacing its values with those from a JSON body file.

Example:
  umbraco content update 3f7a8b2e-... --json-body ./update.json

options.name: --json-body
options.description: Path to a JSON file (or - for stdin) containing the update request body. Required unless --schema is used.

options.name: --schema
options.description: Print the JSON Schema for the --json-body request and exit (no host/auth needed). [default: False]

arguments.name: ID
arguments.description: Content item ID. Required unless --schema is used.

commands.name: delete
commands.description:
Permanently delete a content item by ID. This cannot be undone.

Example:
  umbraco content delete 3f7a8b2e-1234-5678-abcd-ef0123456789

commands.name: publish
commands.description:
Publish a content item, making it live. Optionally target specific cultures.

Examples:
  umbraco content publish 3f7a8b2e-...
  umbraco content publish 3f7a8b2e-... --cultures en-US da-DK

options.name: --cultures
options.description: ISO culture codes to publish (e.g. en-US da-DK). Publishes all cultures if omitted.

commands.name: unpublish
commands.description:
Unpublish a content item, taking it offline. Optionally target specific cultures.

Examples:
  umbraco content unpublish 3f7a8b2e-...
  umbraco content unpublish 3f7a8b2e-... --cultures en-US

options.name: --cultures
options.description: ISO culture codes to unpublish. Unpublishes all cultures if omitted.

commands.name: versions
commands.description:
List the version history of a content item.

Examples:
  umbraco content versions 3f7a8b2e-...
  umbraco content versions 3f7a8b2e-... --culture en-US

options.name: --culture
options.description: ISO culture code to filter versions by (e.g. en-US).

commands.name: rollback
commands.description:
Roll a content item back to a previous version.

The ID is a version ID from 'content versions', not the content ID.

Examples:
  umbraco content rollback 7a1c2d3e-...
  umbraco content rollback 7a1c2d3e-... --culture en-US

options.name: --culture
options.description: ISO culture code to roll back (e.g. en-US).

arguments.name: VERSION_ID
arguments.description: Version ID to roll back to (see 'content versions').

commands.name: trash
commands.description:
Move a content item to the recycle bin (reversible with 'content restore').

Example:
  umbraco content trash 3f7a8b2e-...

commands.name: restore
commands.description:
Restore a content item from the recycle bin.

Examples:
  umbraco content restore 3f7a8b2e-...
  umbraco content restore 3f7a8b2e-... --parent 1a2b3c4d-...

options.name: --parent
options.description: Parent to restore under. Restores to the content root if omitted.

commands.name: empty-recycle-bin
commands.description:
Permanently delete all content items in the recycle bin.

Example:
  umbraco content empty-recycle-bin --yes

commands.name: move
commands.description:
Move a content item under a new parent.

Examples:
  umbraco content move 3f7a8b2e-... --parent 1a2b3c4d-...
  umbraco content move 3f7a8b2e-...   # to the content root

options.name: --parent
options.description: Target parent ID. Moves to the content root if omitted.

commands.name: copy
commands.description:
Copy a content item under a new parent.

Examples:
  umbraco content copy 3f7a8b2e-... --parent 1a2b3c4d-...
  umbraco content copy 3f7a8b2e-... --include-descendants

options.name: --parent
options.description: Target parent ID. Copies to the content root if omitted.

options.name: --include-descendants
options.description: Also copy the item's descendants. [default: False]

options.name: --relate
options.description: Create a relation from the copy back to the original. [default: False]

commands.name: publish-descendants
commands.description:
Publish a content item and its descendants.

Examples:
  umbraco content publish-descendants 3f7a8b2e-...
  umbraco content publish-descendants 3f7a8b2e-... --include-unpublished --cultures en-US

options.name: --cultures
options.description: ISO culture codes to publish. Publishes all cultures if omitted.

options.name: --include-unpublished
options.description: Also publish descendants that have never been published. [default: False]

commands.name: bulk
commands.description:
Run an operation over many content ids read from stdin or a file, with per-item results.

Examples:
  umbraco content list --fields id | umbraco content bulk publish
  umbraco content bulk delete --file ids.txt --yes

commands.name: delete
commands.description:
Permanently delete many content items by id (ids from --file or stdin).

Example:
  umbraco content bulk delete --file ids.txt --yes

options.name: --file
options.description: File of ids (one per line). Reads stdin when omitted.

commands.name: publish
commands.description:
Publish many content items by id (ids from --file or stdin).

Example:
  umbraco content list --fields id | umbraco content bulk publish

options.name: --file
options.description: File of ids (one per line). Reads stdin when omitted.

options.name: --cultures
options.description: ISO culture codes to publish. Publishes all cultures if omitted.

commands.name: unpublish
commands.description:
Unpublish many content items by id (ids from --file or stdin).

Example:
  umbraco content bulk unpublish --file ids.txt

options.name: --file
options.description: File of ids (one per line). Reads stdin when omitted.

options.name: --cultures
options.description: ISO culture codes to unpublish. Unpublishes all cultures if omitted.

commands.name: export
commands.description:
Export a content subtree to a portable JSON snapshot.

Examples:
  umbraco content export --out content.json
  umbraco content export --root 3f7a8b2e-... --out subtree.json
  umbraco content export | jq '.data.documents | length'

options.name: --root
options.description: Export only this document's subtree (root included). Omit for the whole tree.

options.name: --out
options.description: Write the snapshot to this file (bare JSON, no envelope). Omit to write the snapshot to stdout inside the success envelope.

commands.name: diff
commands.description:
Compare a content snapshot against the live instance (read-only).

Examples:
  umbraco content diff content.json
  umbraco content export | umbraco content diff -

arguments.name: SNAPSHOT
arguments.description: Path to a snapshot file produced by 'content export', or '-' for stdin.

commands.name: apply
commands.description:
Apply a content snapshot to the live instance (create + update; --prune also deletes).

Examples:
  umbraco content apply content.json --dry-run
  umbraco content apply content.json
  umbraco content apply content.json --prune --yes

options.name: --prune
options.description: Also DELETE live documents (within the snapshot's scope) that the snapshot does not contain. Destructive: requires --yes when non-interactive. [default: False]

arguments.name: SNAPSHOT
arguments.description: Path to a snapshot file produced by 'content export', or '-' for stdin.

commands.name: media
commands.description:
Manage Umbraco media library items (upload, list, get, delete).

Examples:
  umbraco media list
  umbraco media upload ./photo.jpg --parent <folder-id>
  umbraco media delete <id>

commands.name: list
commands.description:
List media items in the media library.

Examples:
  umbraco media list
  umbraco media list --parent <folder-id> --output json

options.name: --parent
options.description: Filter by parent media folder UUID. Omit for root media items.

commands.name: get
commands.description:
Get a media item by its UUID, including URL and metadata.

Example:
  umbraco media get 3f7a8b2e-...

commands.name: upload
commands.description:
Upload a local file as a media item (staged via temporary-file for large files).

Examples:
  umbraco media upload ./logo.png
  umbraco media upload ./big-video.mp4 --media-type File --name "Promo"
  umbraco media upload ./photo.jpg --parent 3f7a8b2e-...

options.name: --parent
options.description: UUID of the media folder to upload into. Omit for the media root.

options.name: --name
options.description: Display name for the media item. Defaults to the filename.

options.name: --media-type
options.description: Media type to create the item as: a media type id (GUID) or name (e.g. Image, File). Defaults to Image. [default: Image]

commands.name: delete
commands.description:
Permanently delete a media item by UUID.

Example:
  umbraco media delete 3f7a8b2e-...

commands.name: trash
commands.description:
Move a media item to the recycle bin (reversible with 'media restore').

Example:
  umbraco media trash 3f7a8b2e-...

commands.name: restore
commands.description:
Restore a media item from the recycle bin.

Examples:
  umbraco media restore 3f7a8b2e-...
  umbraco media restore 3f7a8b2e-... --parent 1a2b3c4d-...

options.name: --parent
options.description: Folder to restore under. Restores to the media root if omitted.

commands.name: empty-recycle-bin
commands.description:
Permanently delete all media items in the recycle bin.

Example:
  umbraco media empty-recycle-bin --yes

commands.name: move
commands.description:
Move a media item under a new parent folder.

Examples:
  umbraco media move 3f7a8b2e-... --parent 1a2b3c4d-...
  umbraco media move 3f7a8b2e-...   # to the media root

options.name: --parent
options.description: Target folder ID. Moves to the media root if omitted.

commands.name: media-types
commands.description:
List, inspect, and manage Umbraco media types.

Examples:
  umbraco media-types list
  umbraco media-types get 3f7a8b2e-...
  umbraco media-types create --name "Custom Image" --alias customImage

commands.name: list
commands.description:
List media types defined in the Umbraco instance.

Examples:
  umbraco media-types list
  umbraco media-types list --output json | jq '.[].name'

commands.name: get
commands.description:
Get a media type by UUID, including its alias and description.

Example:
  umbraco media-types get 3f7a8b2e-...

commands.name: create
commands.description:
Create a new media type with a given name and alias.

Examples:
  umbraco media-types create --name "Custom Image" --alias customImage
  umbraco media-types create --name "Widget" --alias widget --is-element
  umbraco media-types create --name "Doc" --alias doc --allow-at-root --icon icon-document

options.name: --icon
options.description: Backoffice icon alias (e.g. icon-picture, icon-document). [default: icon-picture]

options.name: --id
options.description: Optional client-supplied UUID for an idempotent create (#86).

commands.name: delete
commands.description:
Delete a media type by UUID. All media of this type must be removed first.

Example:
  umbraco media-types delete 3f7a8b2e-...

commands.name: content-types
commands.description:
List, inspect, and manage Umbraco document types (content types).

Examples:
  umbraco content-types list
  umbraco content-types get textPage
  umbraco content-types create --name "Blog Post" --alias blogPost

commands.name: list
commands.description:
List all document types defined in the Umbraco instance.

Examples:
  umbraco content-types list
  umbraco content-types list --output json | jq '.[].alias'

commands.name: get
commands.description:
Get a document type by UUID or alias, including its property groups.

Examples:
  umbraco content-types get textPage
  umbraco content-types get 3f7a8b2e-...

commands.name: create
commands.description:
Create a new document type with a given name and alias.

Examples:
  umbraco content-types create --name "Blog Post" --alias blogPost
  umbraco content-types create --name "Widget" --alias widget --is-element
  umbraco content-types create --name "Home Page" --alias homePage --allow-at-root --icon icon-home

options.name: --icon
options.description: Backoffice icon alias (e.g. icon-document, icon-home). [default: icon-document]

options.name: --id
options.description: Optional client-supplied UUID for an idempotent create (#86).

commands.name: delete
commands.description:
Delete a document type by UUID. All content of this type must be removed first.

Example:
  umbraco content-types delete 3f7a8b2e-...

commands.name: data-types
commands.description:
List, inspect, and manage Umbraco data types (property editors).

Examples:
  umbraco data-types list --output json
  umbraco data-types create --name "My Text" --editor-alias Umbraco.TextBox --editor-ui-alias Umb.PropertyEditorUi.TextBox

commands.name: list
commands.description:
List all data types (property editors) configured in the Umbraco instance.

Example:
  umbraco data-types list

commands.name: get
commands.description:
Get a data type (property editor) by UUID.

Example:
  umbraco data-types get 3f7a8b2e-...

commands.name: create
commands.description:
Create a data type (property editor configuration).

Example:
  umbraco data-types create --name "My Text" --editor-alias Umbraco.TextBox --editor-ui-alias Umb.PropertyEditorUi.TextBox

options.name: --editor-alias
options.description: Backend property editor alias (e.g. Umbraco.TextBox).

options.name: --editor-ui-alias
options.description: Backoffice editor UI alias (e.g. Umb.PropertyEditorUi.TextBox).

options.name: --id
options.description: Optional client-supplied UUID for an idempotent create (#86).

commands.name: update
commands.description:
Update a data type by UUID. Omitted fields (and editor configuration) are preserved.

Example:
  umbraco data-types update 3f7a8b2e-... --name "My Text"

options.name: --name
options.description: New name.

options.name: --editor-alias
options.description: New backend property editor alias.

options.name: --editor-ui-alias
options.description: New backoffice editor UI alias.

commands.name: delete
commands.description:
Delete a data type by UUID.

Example:
  umbraco data-types delete 3f7a8b2e-...

commands.name: is-used
commands.description: Check whether a data type is used by any content type.

commands.name: referenced-by
commands.description: List what references a data type (raw JSON; the references are a mixed set of kinds).

commands.name: copy
commands.description: Copy a data type, optionally under a target folder.

options.name: --target
options.description: Destination folder UUID; omit to copy to the root.

commands.name: move
commands.description: Move a data type under a folder (or to the root).

options.name: --target
options.description: Destination folder UUID; omit to move to the root.

commands.name: folder
commands.description: Manage data-type folders.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Get a data-type folder by UUID.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a data-type folder.

options.name: --name
options.description: Folder name.

options.name: --parent
options.description: Parent folder UUID. Omit to create at the root.

options.name: --id
options.description: Optional client-supplied UUID for an idempotent create (#86).

commands.name: update
commands.description: Rename a data-type folder by UUID.

options.name: --name
options.description: New folder name.

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a data-type folder by UUID.

commands.name: languages
commands.description:
Manage the languages configured in the Umbraco instance.

Examples:
  umbraco languages list
  umbraco languages create --culture fr-FR
  umbraco languages delete fr-FR

commands.name: list
commands.description:
List all languages configured in the Umbraco instance.

Example:
  umbraco languages list --output json

commands.name: create
commands.description: Add a language.

options.name: --culture
options.description: ISO 4646 culture code for the language (e.g. en-US, fr-FR, da-DK).

options.name: --name
options.description: Display name for the language. Defaults to the culture's display name (e.g. 'French (France)').

options.name: --default
options.description: Set this language as the default for new content. [default: False]

options.name: --mandatory
options.description: Mark this language as mandatory (content must be translated into it). [default: False]

commands.name: update
commands.description:
Update a language by its ISO culture code. Omitted fields are preserved.

Example:
  umbraco languages update fr-FR --name "French (France)" --mandatory

options.name: --name
options.description: New display name for the language.

options.name: --default
options.description: Set/unset this as the default language (--default or --default false).

options.name: --mandatory
options.description: Set/unset content in this language as mandatory.

options.name: --fallback
options.description: ISO code of the fallback language.

arguments.name: ISO_CODE
arguments.description: ISO culture code of the language to update (e.g. fr-FR).

commands.name: delete
commands.description:
Remove a language by its ISO culture code.

Example:
  umbraco languages delete fr-FR

arguments.name: ISO_CODE
arguments.description: ISO culture code of the language to remove (e.g. en-US, fr-FR).

commands.name: templates
commands.description:
List, inspect, and manage Razor view templates defined in the Umbraco instance.

Examples:
  umbraco templates list
  umbraco templates create --name Home --alias home

commands.name: list
commands.description:
List all Razor view templates in the Umbraco instance.

Example:
  umbraco templates list --output json

commands.name: get
commands.description:
Get a template by its alias or id, including the view file content.

Example:
  umbraco templates get master
  umbraco templates get 1a2b3c4d-.....

commands.name: create
commands.description:
Create a Razor view template.

Examples:
  umbraco templates create --name "Blog Post" --alias blogPost
  umbraco templates create --name Home --alias home --content-file ./home.cshtml

options.name: --content
options.description: Razor view content (inline). Mutually exclusive with --content-file.

options.name: --content-file
options.description: Path to a file whose contents become the Razor view.

options.name: --id
options.description: Optional client-supplied UUID for an idempotent create (#86).

commands.name: update
commands.description:
Update a Razor view template by UUID. Omitted fields are preserved.

Example:
  umbraco templates update 3f7a8b2e-... --content-file ./home.cshtml

options.name: --name
options.description: New name.

options.name: --alias
options.description: New alias.

options.name: --content
options.description: Razor view content (inline). Mutually exclusive with --content-file.

options.name: --content-file
options.description: Path to a file whose contents become the Razor view.

commands.name: delete
commands.description:
Delete a Razor view template by UUID.

Example:
  umbraco templates delete 3f7a8b2e-...

commands.name: members
commands.description:
Manage Umbraco front-end members (not back-office users).

Examples:
  umbraco members list
  umbraco members create --email user@example.com --name "Jane Doe" --type Member
  umbraco members delete <id>

commands.name: list
commands.description:
List Umbraco members, optionally filtered by member group.

Examples:
  umbraco members list
  umbraco members list --group Subscribers --output json

commands.name: get
commands.description:
Get a member by their UUID.

Example:
  umbraco members get 3f7a8b2e-...

commands.name: create
commands.description:
Create a new Umbraco member.

Example:
  umbraco members create --email user@example.com --name "Jane Doe" --type Member

options.name: --type
options.description: Alias of the member type (e.g. Member).

options.name: --id
options.description: Optional client-supplied UUID for an idempotent create (#86).

commands.name: update
commands.description:
Update a member's email, name, or approved state by UUID.

Examples:
  umbraco members update 3f7a8b2e-... --name "Jane Roe"
  umbraco members update 3f7a8b2e-... --email jane@example.com --approved

options.name: --email
options.description: New email address.

options.name: --name
options.description: New display name.

options.name: --approved
options.description: Set the member's approved state (--approved or --approved false).

commands.name: delete
commands.description:
Permanently delete a member by UUID.

Example:
  umbraco members delete 3f7a8b2e-...

commands.name: member-types
commands.description:
List, inspect, and manage Umbraco member types.

Examples:
  umbraco member-types list
  umbraco member-types get 3f7a8b2e-...
  umbraco member-types create --name "Author" --alias author

commands.name: list
commands.description:
List member types defined in the Umbraco instance.

Examples:
  umbraco member-types list
  umbraco member-types list --output json | jq '.[].name'

commands.name: get
commands.description:
Get a member type by UUID, including its alias and description.

Example:
  umbraco member-types get 3f7a8b2e-...

commands.name: create
commands.description:

commands.name: schema
commands.description:
Export, diff, and apply Umbraco schema (document types, data types, templates).

Examples:
  umbraco schema export --out schema.json
  umbraco schema diff schema.json
  umbraco schema apply schema.json --dry-run
  umbraco schema apply schema.json --prune --yes

commands.name: export
commands.description:
Export document types, data types, and templates to a portable JSON snapshot.

Examples:
  umbraco schema export --out schema.json
  umbraco schema export | jq '.data.documentTypes | length'

options.name: --out
options.description: Write the snapshot to this file (bare JSON, no envelope). Omit to write the snapshot to stdout inside the success envelope.

commands.name: diff
commands.description:
Compare a schema snapshot against the live instance (read-only).

Examples:
  umbraco schema diff schema.json
  umbraco schema export | umbraco schema diff -

arguments.name: SNAPSHOT
arguments.description: Path to a snapshot file produced by 'schema export', or '-' for stdin.

commands.name: apply
commands.description:
Apply a schema snapshot to the live instance (create + update; --prune also deletes).

Examples:
  umbraco schema apply schema.json --dry-run
  umbraco schema apply schema.json
  umbraco schema apply schema.json --prune --yes

options.name: --prune
options.description: Also DELETE live document types, data types, and templates that the snapshot does not contain. Destructive: requires --yes when non-interactive. [default: False]

arguments.name: SNAPSHOT
arguments.description: Path to a snapshot file produced by 'schema export', or '-' for stdin.
